system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

Uchiha are known for their extreme adaptation on the battlefield. Able to see, comprehend, understand and react all in a hair’s breadth with or without a Sharingan. You can select 2 of the following adaptations. You can select another adaptation at 7th and 15th levels.

Amplified Defense

You are able to amplify your reaction speed, reacting more than others in short bursts. You gain an additional reaction. Once you use this adaptations bonus reaction, you cannot do so again until 10 minutes have passed. Beginning at 7th level, you can use this bonus reaction twice per 10 minutes. As usual you cannot take multiple reactions against the same trigger.

Amplified Flames

Uchiha hare often hailed as the Fire release specialists of the Land of Fire. Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Fire Release keyword, that affects an area you can increase the size of the area by +5 feet. This increases to +10 at 7th and +15 at 15th.

Amplified Retaliation

The Uchiha has a strong love for their allies and will punish anyone who would dare attempt to harm them. Once per turn, when a hostile creature within 15 feet of you makes an attack targeting you or an allied creature, you can spend your reaction to move up to half your movement, ending that movement within your weapons attack range and make an attack of opportunity against them. On a hit they must make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.

Agile Fist

The Uchiha clan are masters of a highly agile form of combat known as the Agile Fist. This stance is treated as both a Taijutsu and Bukijutsu stance because of its ability to integrate both unarmed and weapon based martial options into the flow of combat.

You can enter the Agile Fist stance as a bonus action. While you are in this stance you gain the following benefits.

Your [Unarmed Damage] becomes 1d6 and the damage die of weapons you wield that are smaller than a d6, become d6.

Beginning at 7th level, if you do not have the Extra Attack class feature, you can attack twice while in this stance when you take the Attack action.

You can use your Hijutsu Flexibility ability mod in place of strength for Unarmed and Weapon attack and damage

When you take damage from an attack, you can spend your reaction to use half of your AC, as your DR vs the triggering damage. If you reduce the damage by half or more, you can use Great Assault as part of the same reaction.

As an Action you can perform the Great Assault attack.

Great Assault. Make melee or ranged Jutsu attack (60 Feet), using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see, striking fast enough to fluster your foes, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] + [Weapon Damage] and forcing them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your attack types associated saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save. Beginning at 7th level, you can make a number of attacks with this ability equal to the number of attacks you can make with the Attack action.

Shurikenjutsu

The Uchiha clan are often seen as unparalleled specialist of thrown weapons. Once per turn, when casting a jutsu that uses a weapon with the Ammunition property, they do not roll their ammunition dice. Additionally, once per turn, when you deal [Weapon Damage] with a weapon with the Thrown or Ammunition property, you can force them to make a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw vs your highest saving throw, becoming Off-Guard until the end of your next turn on a failed save.
